# Local file fingerprint runtime
Actual adopted repository https://github.com/blueimp/JavaScript-MD5, version2.19.0, npm gitHead458b6624c39df94cd938db3303ef77aa1e7a6800. Official registry archive SHA1 verified before extracting; no install/build/test scripts executed, no runtime dependencies. Original js/md5.js retained byte-for-byte as md5.original.js. md5-binary.js differs only in adding fileMD5Binary(s) which calls original rstrMD5 and rstr2hex, avoiding public UTF8 string API re-encoding arbitrary bytes. See ADAPTER.patch. No algorithm rewritten. Original file uses own arithmetic, no external imports/remote assets/Babel helpers.
Original MIT2011 Sebastian Tschan retained, embedded Paul Johnston1999–2009 BSD attribution retained. Original author https://pajhome.org.uk/crypt/md5/index.html actually links https://pajhome.org.uk/site/legal.html#bsdlicense; original full BSD grant retained in PAUL_JOHNSTON_BSD.txt and original MD5 section's RSA derived-algorithm notice retained separately. Derived from the RSA Data Security, Inc. MD5 Message-Digest Algorithm. License display/wording not substituted by a generic SPDX badge.
Initial SparkMD5 3.0.2 candidate was not adopted: original JKM Joseph Myers source and explanation were read but complete original grant not found in that finite check. This is a distribution-evidence gap, not an infringement conclusion. No Spark runtime shipped or counted. Blueimp is the only alternative reviewed.
Platform task: self-selected file <=8MiB, Worker reads1MiB chunks with FileReaderSync then combines bounded binary strings for one original core call. Chunked reading is NOT incremental hashing. Memory contains chunks, joined string and original word array, intentionally bounded by8MiB (not64MiB). Whole task8s main-thread deadline terminates Worker. Empty file allowed; optional expected32 hex MD5 comparison; TXTJSON≤8KiB. No file names/paths or bytes sent to server. MD5 has known collision weaknesses; file fingerprint/transfer-error check only, not tamper-proofing, credentials, signatures or virus detection.

Fixed-commit GitHub LICENSE.txt actually read and agrees with original MIT text; not a source build reproduction. Windows browser verification8 groups plus one client-unmount check separately; Python hashlib checked12 actual TXT/JSON against empty,abc,0x80/0xff,UTF8,2MiB+17 cross-chunk and8MiB bytes. Timeout is controlled infinite-Worker injection, not an observed algorithm hang. Exact memory usage/real mobile/background deadline precision not benchmarked; browser timers can be throttled.
